subject: trouble with multi_normal_prec in RStan 2.0.1 on Mac OS X Mavericks.

messages.author: e5ad4e08645f3bdf
messages.subject: trouble with multi_normal_prec in RStan 2.0.1 on Mac OS X Mavericks.
parts:
Hi there. I'm having trouble using multi_normal_prec in RStan. If I make the following call:

stan(model_code='data{int N; vector[2] x[N]; vector[2] mu;} 
                 parameters{cov_matrix[2] Tau;} 
                 model{for(i in 1:N){ x[i] ~ multi_normal_prec(mu,Tau);}}',
     data=list(N=100,x=mvrnorm(n=100,mu=c(0,0),Sigma=diag(2)),mu=c(0,0)),iter=100)


I get this error:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! filefc2639f704e.cpp:142:28: error: no template named 'multi_normal_prec_log'; did you mean 'matrix_normal_prec_log'?
            lp_accum__.add(multi_normal_prec_log<propto__>(get_base1(x,i,"x",1), mu, Tau));
                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                           matrix_normal_prec_log
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/rstan/include//stansrc/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/matrix_normal.hpp:41:5: note: 'matrix_normal_prec_log' declared here
    matrix_normal_prec_log(const Eigen::Matrix<T_y,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic>& y,
    ^
filefc2639f704e.cpp:142:28: error: no matching function for call to 'matrix_normal_prec_log'
            lp_accum__.add(multi_normal_prec_log<propto__>(get_base1(x,i,"x",1), mu, Tau));
                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/rstan/include//stansrc/sta

But everything works fine if I change to the following:

stan(model_code='data{int N; vector[2] x[N]; vector[2] mu;} 
                 parameters{cov_matrix[2] Sigma;} 
                 model{x ~ multi_normal(mu,Sigma);}',
     data=list(N=100,x=mvrnorm(n=100,mu=c(0,0),Sigma=diag(2)),mu=c(0,0)),iter=100)

Here's the output of clang++ --version:

Apple LLVM version 5.0 (clang-500.2.79) (based on LLVM 3.3svn)
Target: x86_64-apple-darwin13.0.0
Thread model: posix

I just upgraded to Mac OS X Mavericks and installed the latest version of R (3.0.2) and RStan (2.0.1). This was working fine before the upgrades.
